source_text_context.text: The perpetrators were their male counterparts within their peer groups. School boys were the major perpetrators. source_text_context.text: I would like to say that helping a girl could be different, you are not an  angel to come from nowhere and start helping every  strange girl you meet. When it comes to school fees, then she has parents to cater for that. Maybe it could be a college issue, then you guys will have to sit down and agree of a few terms. Helping again has a different direction, as for me I have a sister who stay with the sister to my grandfather, so I have to chip in a support her stay in school because it is my responsibility since she is an orphan and I do sympathise with her whenever she is sent for school fees and other small items. I cannot let her look for support elsewhere in exchange of sex and since is the one taking care of our grandmother. So I have to try my best to provide her with the support to help her stay in school. What I understand, for instance a man cannot buy he a calculator costing fifteen hundred shillings for free that is a lie, she will have to pay for that with sex. So as I pluck my vegatables to get money, I do support her to my capacity. But any lady who you want to support by paying her school fees to complete her studies is a different scenario.

source_text_context.text: Yes. I will speak as a leader in the place where we are and also as someone who frequently engages with the youths at another category. Sometimes you can be chased from your place of work, sometimes there are those we hand over to the Authorities. You know authorities can sometimes be many.
